name: garbage doll
source:
welcome to garbage doll, an empty spaces toxic yuri visual novel about a doll who finds itself in the trash and decides to do something about it, defying the voice in its head that advises it to stay put.

[From [url=https://jammyjams.itch.io/garbage-doll]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
歡迎來到《garbage doll》。這是一部屬於「空白空間」題材的有毒百合視覺小說。一個人偶發現自己被丟進垃圾堆，決定做點什麼改變現狀，違抗腦海中那個勸自己乖乖待著的聲音。

［取自[url=https://jammyjams.itch.io/garbage-doll]itch.io[/url]］
